title: Lunar New Year Logistics Announcement
content: Hello to all our dear Three-Cup Duck fans! As we begin the new year, we would like to share the latest update regarding our logistics. During the 2024 Lunar New Year period, delivery times may be delayed due to the holiday schedules of our shipping partners.
content2: Details are as follows: January 20th to January 30th, 2024: Logistics companies will conduct year-end inventory checks, which may cause delivery delays. Starting February 1st, 2024: All delivery services will return to normal. To ensure you receive your favorite products on time, we recommend placing your orders in advance. Our customer service team will provide full support during this period to answer any questions and assist with orders. If you have any inquiries, please feel free to contact our hotline or email us. Thank you again for your support and understanding. We wish you a Happy New Year and all the best!

title: Pop-up Collaboration Notice
content: Dear customers, we are thrilled to announce that Three-Cup Duck is launching an exciting pop-up collaboration! This time, we are partnering with the renowned illustrator Mia to release a limited edition hand-painted mug series. The collaboration products will officially launch on April 1st, 2024. The designs are full of warmth and fun, combining duck elements to add infinite joy to your life.
content2: This limited edition mug series will be available exclusively on our official website and at partner retail stores. Quantities are limited and available only while stocks last. To give everyone a better chance at securing these limited items, we will host a live stream on the launch day. Mia will personally introduce the design concepts and answer fan questions. Please follow our official website and social media for the latest news. Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to witnessing this wonderful collaboration with you!

title: Shipping Fee Adjustment Notice
content: Dear customers, thank you for your long-term support of Three-Cup Duck. To provide better logistics services, we will be adjusting our shipping fees. The changes are as follows: Standard Delivery: Shipping fee adjusted to $60, with free shipping on orders over $500.
content2: Express Delivery: Shipping fee adjusted to $100, with free shipping on orders over $1000. The new shipping policy will officially take effect on June 1st, 2024. This adjustment aims to improve our logistics efficiency so you can receive your beloved products faster. We will continue to optimize our delivery services to provide a more convenient and efficient shopping experience. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact our customer service team. We are happy to assist you. Thank you for your understanding and support, and happy shopping!

title: Exclusive Member Benefits
content: Dear members, to thank you for your continued support and love, we are excited to announce that the Three-Cup Duck Exclusive Member Benefits event is about to begin! Starting July 10th, 2024, we have prepared a series of exclusive offers for our members:
content2: Member Day: The 15th of every month is Member Day, featuring 10% off sitewide. Becoming a member of Three-Cup Duck not only gives you more discounts but also lets you experience more surprises with us. Please stay tuned to our official website and social media for more details. Thank you for your support and companionship; we will continue to provide you with the highest quality products and services.

content2: The KOLs noted that Three-Cup Duck mugs are not only beautifully designed with outstanding texture but are also highly practical—bringing a joyful experience whether used for coffee, tea, or other beverages. they especially praised the creative designs, calling them the perfect choice for gifting.
